4Q71 f1:6.en: And in nails they are strengthened and do not totter. As a date-palm of hammered work they are, and do not speak. Silver stamped from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, and the work of the hands of the wise, all of them purple wool and purple-wool.

4Q71 f1:7.en: [Their] clothing will not be taken away, nor will they be taken away, for they will not march in fear, because no harm will come to them, nor will any good come to them. As you say to the gods of heaven and earth, they have not served
